name: The Lost Storm
description: An isometric action RPG. Wake in a white mist, walk out into a hall under a night storm, and fight what the lightning leaves behind. Find loot, level up and shape your hero on a skill tree of 125 places.
author: marginsystems
controls: Left click to move and attack
Q / W / E / R and right click for skills
I inventory, C character, T skill tree
Hold Alt to show item names
